Example GSEA input (fgsea example data)

Source: R/data.R
example_gsea.Rd

A gene set enrichment analysis bundle for the gseaEnrichmentPlotServer() module, in the form the module takes: gene-level statistics, gene sets, and their fgsea results. Built from the example data of the fgsea package (exampleRanks, examplePathways; MIT licence): a ranked list of about 12,000 mouse genes (Entrez IDs) and the 40 Reactome pathways fgsea ranks most significant for it.

Usage

data(example_gsea)

Format

A list with three elements:

stats

Named numeric vector of gene-level statistics (names are Entrez IDs)

pathways

Named list of 40 gene sets (vectors of Entrez IDs)

results

The fgsea::fgsea() results for those sets: pathway, pval, padj, log2err, ES, NES, size, leadingEdge

Source

Generated by data-raw/generate_example_gsea.R from the fgsea package (Korotkevich et al., 2016, bioRxiv, doi:10.1101/060012).

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

data(example_gsea)
head(example_gsea$results[, c("pathway", "NES", "padj")])

#> 1                              5990980_Cell_Cycle 2.705894 4.663205e-24
